purpose: Verify the pinned AURA mathematical source baseline and report source drift before Math begins M1 extraction.
requested_actions: Compare the pinned selected mathematical sources/tests against the recipient's current AURA revision and identify every changed selected file.
Confirm that the listed direct-transfer candidates still represent the mathematical core intended for extraction.
Confirm the retained host boundary for dw.localization, MathCultureResolver, UnitCatalog presentation/facade behavior, UnitLocalization, and UnitProjection.
Confirm the transitive AURA consumers that must be revalidated at later adoption: core math actions, kernel, nutrition, data transforms, SQLite, JSON, and worker/CLI paths.
Do not remove, replace, or migrate any AURA source during this baseline request.
non_goals: No AURA code removal or reference cutover.
No change to AURA permissions, worker policies, configuration, persisted formats, or public behavior.
No cross-repository write by the Math agent.
host_validation: Report exact changed selected files relative to the pinned source manifest.
Identify relevant pure-math tests and host-facing tests that must remain in AURA.
Identify any current consumer/reference not represented by the Math inventory.
Do not claim clean-tree state unless independently verified.
rollback: Not applicable to baseline verification because this request asks for no AURA mutation.

expected_response.note: A baseline acknowledgement does not equal later Math-package adoption.
